- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_flow] Guided Photo Upload Quality Sub-Flow: Add real-time photo tips and validation micro-components to upload_photos screen to guide users through custom pet creation. (why: Users submitted support tickets about custom pet generation failing or looking distorted.)
1: [choose_path, reorder] Move Story Intro Before Path Selection: Reorder onboarding so the narrative story plays before asking users to select their pet creation path. (why: Users take a long time on choose_path (mean 514s), indicating a lack of emotional context before deciding.)
2: [home, wait_info] Interactive Mini-Game During Wait Screen: Add an engaging tip carousel and animated progress status to the waiting screen while the pet generates. (why: The waiting step has high latency (mean 2336s), causing user impatience and drop-off.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Account Pet Preservation Hint on Sign-In: Display an explicit hint on sign_in clarifying that logging in links and saves pets safely to the user account. (why: 8 support emails cited missing or reset pets after signing back into the application.)
4: [finish, copy] Desktop Pet Visibility Troubleshooting Guide: Add display tips and multi-monitor visibility troubleshooting instructions to the home_intro screen. (why: Support logs contain multiple reports of pets failing to render on screen or desktop overlay issues.)
5: [choose_path, layout] Split-Screen Pathway Selection Layout: Switch choose_path layout to 'split' presenting Premade vs Custom pet options side-by-side with clear visuals. (why: choose_path takes median 8s but mean 514s; side-by-side comparison reduces cognitive load.)
6: [home, notification] Background Notification Progress Toggle: Enable background ready notifications and time estimate on the generation waiting screen. (why: Long mean wait time (2336s) leads to app abandonment if users switch away while waiting.)

Sign-in step loses 27.1% and 8 support emails directly cite confusion about saved pets; quick text fix.
Finish step drops 35.2% and support logs report rendering issues; copy update is low cost.
Discrepancy between median (8s) and mean (514s) signals confusion; split layout clarifies choices.
Addresses long 2336s wait time at home step by allowing users to leave app safely.
